description:
Häagen Dazs Strawberries & Cream is a creamy, fruity tub of summer deliciousness. It's an ice cream that you can count on when you can't make your own but when you can........ now is the time to look at making a better version of Häagen Dazs Strawberries & Cream and whilst at it....making it vegan or plant based. 

The key here (as i've recently found) is the use of carnation vegan condensed milk. It really is a revelation and I thinkk you'll find out why when you make this recipe. Can get this carnation vegan condensed milk where you are?

What you will need:

500g Ripe strawberries 
100g Sugar
Splash of lemon juice
370g Carnation vegan condensed milk 
500g Vegan/Plant Based cream (Elmlea Plant Based)
50g Glucose
40g Vegan milk (low flavour type like rice milk or oat milk)

You'll macerate the strawberries for a little bit with the sugar and lemon juice then cook them out. 

I was so impressed with this recipe that i'm going to make a Belgian Chocolate Vegan recipe to try and match Häagen Dazs Belgian Chocolate using a similar method so make sure you subscribe and click that bell so you don't miss it.

comments.text: How do you feel about the idea that cooking the strawberries changes the flavor or makes it worse for ice cream in some way? I’ve been looking to make a strawberry ice cream but there’s a lot of confusing information online
comments.author: @CheesyManGamer

comments.text:
Dairy dulls the flavour of everything you put in there, if you create a strong reduction, you won’t have an issue. 
It’s unfortunate that some people want the EXACT taste of something after adding it to lots of other ingredients. The only way to have as “natural” flavour as possible is to go ultra low fat or sorbet. 
There are probably 50 ways to make fruit ice creams but they’ll all end up similar.
comments.author: @PolarIceCreamery

comments.text: Thanks for this amazing recipe. I just would like to know what makes an icecream hard or soft ? I do understand you mentioning something about sugar in this video but didn't properly get what you meant. My non-vegan variant, following the other comment in the video, came out a bit hard after frozen. Also what is the role of glucose syrup in the recipe. ? Thanks again
comments.author: @usman_oz

comments.text:
Sugar, it’s all about sugars. Types of sugar, how much sugar etc. the glucose is a type of sugar that affects the freezing point aka how hard or soft it is in the freezer. 
If the recipes are changed, even a little bit, it will change the result. That’s just how ice cream making is. 
I’ll do a big video on sugars next month so keep an eye out.
